name: Support Kira/Brennan A
_source: speak;Brennan;Your father spoke of you every campaign. 'Kira would have seen that faster.'
speak;Brennan;He was proud. Wanted you to know but never quite managed.
speak;Kira;Some things you leave unsaid too long.
speak;Brennan;You'll have more time. I'll make sure of it.
speak;Brennan;It's kept me alive this long.
